summary: Iteration 13 (live Fishing Duel, re-login to harbour, map switching, painted icons and navy palette, Sea Serpent, no external links). Backend: new test_iter13_live_duel.py, 3/3 pass. Covered: queue gives waiting then matched; countdown phase; both players get the same match id; leave during countdown returns 400; a fish landed via cast and land during the live window adds kg, catches and best, and the foe sees it; the winner got +500 gold (4570 -> 5070). Frontend: two-context duel works. Both players switch to data-mode=duel, the chip reads 'Duel Pier', the scoreboard shows both names and kg, and the timer goes from 'Starts in N' to m:ss, kept in sync on both sides. fish-1..4 all show the cast hint and FISH is enabled. In-app quests nav is blocked. CRITICAL BUG: the result screen is broken. When the timer ends, player 1 saw duel-result for about 1-2s before being sent to the harbour, and player 2 never saw it at all. Re-login from water mode lands in the harbour. Switching harbour -> Millbrook -> harbour renders in under 400ms. Menus have no px-icon or crispEdges svgs and no broken images. The game pages have no external a[href^=http] links.

critical.issue: _settle sets state='done' globally when it pays the winner, and _active filters out state 'done'. So the first state or queue poll after the end (by either player) settles the match. Every later poll then returns {state:'idle'} for BOTH players. Reproduced via curl: TestAngler's poll got phase done/win, then TestAngler2 immediately got state 'idle', and vice versa. As a result the loser or second poller never receives phase='done', result or reward.

minor.issue: No level gate. DUEL_LEVEL=10 exists for the old duel, but a level-6 TestAngler can queue for the live duel. Confirm this is intended.
A hex_hook twin catch is not added to the duel kg. Only the main weight is recorded. Probably fine, but confirm.

ui_bugs.issue: Follows from the backend bug. When the state goes to idle, the 'gone' counter calls goMode('harbour') after 3 polls. So the winner sees duel-result for about 1-2s and the other player is dropped to the harbour with no Victory/Defeat/Draw screen. duel-back-harbour is effectively unreachable. Observed live: at end, res1=True and res2=False with p2 already in harbour mode; 1s later both were in harbour with no result.
The ship sprite uses flip:true. The bow now points right, to the sea, and the dock posts are drawn in front, but the 'Sea Serpent' name on the hull is mirrored and reads backwards.

Reloading the page during a duel resets fr_mode duel -> harbour (World.js line 91), so the player loses the duel HUD. They can only rejoin by opening /game/duel and pressing Find again. Also, Travel Map (menu-waters) is still on the duel action bar: clicking it left the URL at /game/waters (mode stayed duel).

integration_issues.issue: Not verified. Pressing Space or FISH on fish-1 did not show fight-panel within 10s, twice. It may have been a 'nothing' bite or a long bite delay. The backend cast and land path into duel kg is verified.

issues: Locked achievement cards use .journal-cell with background rgba(26,15,7,0.9), which is brown, from game-skin.css line 65. This is not the navy palette (103 cards).
fr-btn-dark (brown gradient #3b2514 to #1a0f07) and the sonner toast background #1a0f07 are still brown.
The player card (top-left) and the modal outer frame are wood/brown. Confirm this is intended.
In the duel, both players spawn at the same point (1100,1230), so their name labels overlap ('TeTestAngler2').

action_items: CRITICAL: fix live-duel end-of-match. Keep done matches visible to each player until that player acknowledges them, e.g. a per-player 'seen'/'left' flag set by /duel/live/leave. Do not set a global state='done' in _settle, and include settled matches in _active for a grace window.
Frontend DuelHud: once phase=done has been shown, do not auto-goMode('harbour') on idle polls. Only leave via duel-back-harbour.
Hide Travel Map (menu-waters) in duel mode, or make sure the /game/waters redirect fires.
Optionally restore duel mode on reload when /duel/live/state returns an active match.
Fix the mirrored 'Sea Serpent' hull text: use a pre-flipped asset instead of flipping the sprite.
Convert the remaining brown surfaces (.journal-cell, fr-btn-dark, toasts) to navy if a single palette is required.
critical_code_review_comments: duel_live._settle: the global state='done' write is the root cause of the missing result screen (see RCA).
DuelHud startIn uses the client clock (new Date(m.start) - Date.now()). With clock skew the countdown is wrong. Use seconds_left minus 180 from the server instead.
duel_live.record_catch matches on start<=now<end only, without state. This is fine, but there is no index on live_duels players.id.
duel_live.live_queue has a race: two simultaneous queues can each find nothing and both wait. This is acceptable because they match on the next 2s poll.

success_rate.backend: 100% (3/3 pytest); end-of-match visibility bug found via curl

seed_data_creation: Ran several live duels between TestAngler and TestAngler2. TestAngler won one, +500 gold (now 5070), and landed 1 Yellow Perch.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest test_iter13_live_duel.py -n 0. The queue test waits for any leftover match to clear, up to about 4 min. Login returns 'token', not access_token. Cast returns {result:'hooked', encounter:{id,stamina}}. Land body: {encounter_id, success:true, elapsed:stamina+0.5, game_time, holds:[[..]]} after sleeping about 0.8*stamina. For the UI duel, use 2 contexts with the token in localStorage owo_token and fr_mode=harbour. Open /game/duel and click duel-find on both. In the second context use state='attached' waits, because visibility waits flake while Pixi renders. To verify the result-screen fix you must wait the full 3 min plus 6s.
rca of the issue: Repro: match the two players and let 180s pass. The first /duel/live/state call after end runs _settle, which pays the winner and sets state:'done'. _active() then excludes the match, so the next call from either user returns {state:'idle'}. DuelHud counts 3 idle polls (gone>2) and dispatches fr-mode harbour, which unmounts the result overlay. The second player never got phase=done. Fix: drop the state:'done' write in _settle (keep paid:true). Have _active return the match while end > now-GRACE and the user is not in m.left[]. /duel/live/leave adds the user to left[]. In the frontend, stop auto-leaving after a done result.
